description: This file defines the 'AdminUserRole' class in the OrangeHRM system, serving as a user role with various permissions and access control mechanisms within the HR management platform. It includes multiple traits, methods for retrieving accessible entity IDs based on permissions, and class dependencies, indicating its role in managing user permissions for administrative functionalities.

classes.name: AdminUserRole
classes.description: Class representing the administrative user role with permissions and access control functionalities within OrangeHRM.
